metadata.description: Littlebird's official Claude skill marketplace. Thirty skills built on the Littlebird MCP, covering money and vendor spend, lead generation, meetings and follow-through, personal productivity, knowledge capture, and personal writing voice. Each one is grounded in its own archived research and carries timestamped receipts for every claim.

plugins.name: littlebird-toolkit
plugins.description: Thirty skills that turn your Littlebird memory into work you can act on: SaaS spend and zombie subscription auditing, renewal and receivables watch, pipeline reconstruction, keyword campaign lead harvesting, CRM piping, content repurposing and testimonial mining, competitor tracking, meeting recaps and a two-way commitment ledger, pre-call briefs, daily and weekly digests, SOP generation from captured work, dev logs, a personal troubleshooting knowledge base, project documentation packs, evidence-graded person research, draft voice QA, routine auditing, and personal writing-voice cloning. Requires the Littlebird MCP on a Power or Pro plan.
